scope: Five fixed Imagegen full-screen concepts, read-only independent game_reviewer; no PixelLab or runtime assessment
verdict: APPROVE as five concept variants; user acceptance remains open
shared: Four readable top tabs, three squad cards, literal largely matte wood button faces; no bright gold selected-card frame.
W01: Airy pale ash, ink-like edges, readable but flatter and less tactile.
W02: Dark rugged matte oak and iron corner brackets; strong contrast, less distinct from prior dark-wood concept.
W03: Carved wooden ends, soft bevel, dry walnut, clear CTA and quiet ochre-red selection; best balance.
W04: Stitched red/blue end wraps distinguish it, wood stays visible; bright stitches and cloth make edges busier.
W05: Most literal carpentry with two-board seams and pegs; matte/rustic, but seam behind lettering and rough edges are busier.
caveat: W01/W03/W04 frame around information row '7 комнат' can suggest an interactive button. No concept blocker.
